name: scene3d_add_objects
description: Batch-add scene objects (up to ~20 per call; split larger builds into multiple calls to avoid truncated output). Backend mints ids; never fabricate. entityType ∈ {person,object,image-ref}; personMode:motion creates the SOMA actor rig used by generated performances. faceToward uses forwardAxis (+Z for actors/assets/parts). Sculpt named objects from primitives/parts[] by default; use libraryObjectId from scene3d_search_library_objects for vehicles or a specific/photoreal model. @see guides_get('scene3d')

groupId.description: Batch default: clusters every object in this call under one frontend group. Invent an opaque id (e.g. "pyramid-1"); same id across calls joins the same group. Per-object groupId overrides this.

groupLabel.description: Human label for groupId, first use only.

objects.description: Up to ~20 per call (hard max 30). Split larger builds across multiple calls.

color.description: Hex #RRGGBB. Realistic material hue; vary adjacent boxes slightly — neon only for genuinely lit signage.

entityType.description: person | object | image-ref. image-ref has no mesh; one per sourceCreationId, a repeat returns the existing one. An asset-less person is always a SOMA actor, never a legacy mannequin.

faceToward.description: Ground point to look at; sets rotationY using forwardAxis.

forwardAxis.description: Optional authored front: positiveZ (default; SOMA/assets) or negativeZ (custom asset).

glbUrl.description: Durable GLB URL, such as a library object's CDN URL. Never a creation's signed URL: it expires, and the object vanishes for everyone — pass that creation as sourceCreationId.

groupId.description: Overrides the batch groupId for this object.

libraryObjectId.description: Curated catalog id from scene3d_search_library_objects. Resolves the GLB + curated scale/rotation. Prefer for a named real object.

parts.description: Compound object: several part shapes (mix cube/sphere/…) forming ONE object the UI handles as a unit. Use for a car/tree/animal instead of many separate objects. A wheel = cylinder tilted with rotationX/Z 90. The object transform/faceToward move the whole group.

offset.description: Local position of the part CENTER in world units, not its base (origin = object base center). Standing part of height h → offset.y=h/2; a slab resting on those legs → offset.y=h+slab_height/2 (else the top floats above the legs).

primitiveDimensions.description: World units (meters ÷ 2.2). cube = box w×h×d. cylinder/cone stand along Y: width & depth = base diameters, height = length along that axis.

primitiveType.description: cube | sphere | cylinder | cone | plane | torus | tube | wedge | pyramid | dome — mix freely per part. Default cube.

rotationX.description: Degrees. Tilt on X — lay a cylinder flat as a wheel (axle along Z) with 90.

rotationY.description: Degrees. Default 0. Only spins an upright part about vertical.

rotationZ.description: Degrees. Tilt on Z — wheel with axle along X.

personMode.description: person only: motion. Always send motion for a human; the server owns the SOMA rig URL/actorKind.

pose.description: person only — stance: Relaxed | Walking | Running | Sitting | Crouching | Kneeling | Jumping | Kick | Celebration | Dance. Default Relaxed (standing). Pick the closest.

primitiveDimensions.description: World units, NOT meters — units = meters ÷ 2.2 (person 0.8u, counter ≈0.5u, room wall ≈1.4u). floor=wide+thin, wall=tall+thin; a table/chair is a parts[] compound, not one raised box.

primitiveType.description: Use 'cube' — build everything (floor, walls, furniture) as boxes sized via primitiveDimensions. Required when not using glbUrl/sourceCreationId.

realSizeM.description: Real-world length of the LONGEST dimension in meters (person 1.75, car ~4.5). Wins over transform.scale. Asset objects only (glbUrl/sourceCreationId/libraryObjectId).

sourceCreationId.description: Sqid of a 3D model creation, such as a GLB the user attached (`Attached 3d … id=<sqid>`). The scene re-resolves its model on every load.

transform.description: World units (1u≈2.2m), NOT meters. x,z required; y/scale default to floor + UI size when omitted.

scale.description: Uniform multiplier. Omit when primitiveDimensions set (they are literal).

y.description: Object BASE (bottom), never its vertical center — no height/2. Omit to rest on the ground.
